outline: This course is to introduce techniques and theories for data management. Topics include: 1. Introduction 2. Structural Query Langugage 3. Relational Model and Normalization 4. Database Design 5. Entity-Relationship Model 6. Managing Multiuser Databases 7. Managing Databases with MySQL 8. Web Server Concepts 9. XML 10. Database Processing for Business Intelligence Systems.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Structural Query Langugage, Relational Model and Normalization
Week 3: Database Design and Entity-Relationship Model
Week 4~5: Managing Multiuser Databases
Week 6~9: Managing Databases with MySQL
Week 10~11: Web Server Concepts
Week 12~13: XML
Week 14~16: Database Processing for Business Intelligence Systems
Week 17~18: Project
